datasets.name: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By)
datasets.access_type: OPEN — No registration required. Freely downloadable via HTTPS.

format.seizure_label_format: Seizure Start Time / Seizure End Time in seconds

seizure_types.annotation_granularity: Binary only (Seizure/Non-Seizure). Subtype labels NOT systematically provided in summary files.

known_limitations: 23 channel count — some recordings may have fewer active channels.
No systematic subtype annotations (Focal vs Generalized) in summary files.
Some patients have very few seizure events (chb12 has only 3 seizures).
chb24 uses different channel configuration from other patients.

datasets.name: Siena Scalp EEG Dataset
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By)
datasets.access_type: OPEN — No registration required. Freely downloadable via HTTPS.

format.annotation_format: Text seizure list files (Seizures-list-PN*.txt) per patient

seizure_types.annotation_granularity: Binary only (Seizure/Non-Seizure). Adult focal onset seizures.

known_limitations: 512 Hz sampling rate requires anti-aliased downsampling to 256 Hz for CHB-MIT harmonization.
29 monopolar channels vs 23 bipolar CHB-MIT channels — direct comparison impossible without re-referencing.
Annotation uses clock-time strings, not seconds offsets — requires timestamp parsing relative to EDF start.
Smaller cohort (14 patients, 47 seizures) — limited statistical power for cross-patient generalization.
Adult-only population introduces demographic domain shift vs CHB-MIT pediatric population.
